text: I successfully scaffolded the Next.js app (`npx create-next-app@latest` completed), installed all three CopilotKit packages (`npm install` added 856 packages), and created the `.env`, API route (`app/api/copilotkit/route.ts`), layout, and page files exactly as the quickstart specifies. The dev server starts and prints `▲ Next.js 16.3.0 (Turbopack)` and `✓ Ready in 378ms`, but it crashes during the `○ Compiling / ...` phase—no process remains listening on port 3000, and `curl` returns connection refused. The production build also fails (gets killed after `Creating an optimized production build`), so I could not verify a working copilot endpoint. The blocker appears to be the Next.js compiler crashing or hanging when processing the CopilotKit packages in this sandbox environment.
